channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Blues Goalie Jordan Binnington's Stellar Olympics Should Raise His Trade Value
item.description: St. Louis Blues goalie Jordan Binnington earned the starter's gig at the Olympics and played well for Team Canada. That should make him the top goalie available on the trade front as the Blues struggle.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Will The Oilers And Sharks Acquire A Defenseman?
item.description: With the March 6 NHL trade deadline fast approaching, the Edmonton Oilers and San Jose Sharks are believed to be in the market for defensemen.

item.title: Avalanche Trade Samuel Girard, Draft Pick To Penguins For Brett Kulak
item.description: The Avalanche cleared cap space by acquiring defensive defenseman Brett Kulak from the Pittsburgh Penguins in exchange for D-man Samuel Girard and a second-round pick.

item.title: NHL Vezina Trophy Rankings: Vasilevskiy Overtakes Sorokin
item.description: The Tampa Bay Lightning and New York Islanders have two star netminders battling for the Vezina Trophy. But did Connor Hellebuyck's Olympic performance make up for his stats this NHL season?

item.title: Jack Hughes Says U.S. Olympic Men's Team Is Tight With The Women's Squad Amid Backlash About Group Call With President
item.description: Jack Hughes, who scored the gold medal-winning goal for Team USA on Sunday, said the men's squad is very tight with the American women's team, which also won gold. His comments come after an exchange between U.S. president Donald Trump and the men's team surfaced on social media.

item.title: The Wraparound: Was Coaching The Downfall For Sweden's Olympic Men's Team?
item.description: Emma Linga, Michael Augello and Frank Zawrazky discuss whether Slovakia can become a top-tier hockey nation, Sweden's lineup decisions, the Avalanche and Penguins' trade and much more.

item.title: Projecting Team Canada's 2030 Olympic Men's Hockey Roster
item.description: Following Team Canada's defeat in the gold medal game to Team USA on Sunday, here is its way-too-early projected roster for the 2030 Olympic Games.

item.title: Avalanche Make Low-Risk, High-Reward Move With Brett Kulak Trade
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche tweaked their already dominant defense, acquiring veteran D-man Brett Kulak from the Pittsburgh Penguins. The move also frees up cap space for Colorado, positioning the Avs to make more significant deals.

item.title: Dallas Stars Must Battle For Home-Ice Advantage Without Mikko Rantanen For Now
item.description: Dallas Stars right winger Mikko Rantanen's injury during the Olympics is leaving his team reeling for the next couple of weeks. And any trades by the March 6 deadline won't fill the gap.

item.title: Team USA's Connor Hellebuyck To Receive Presidential Medal Of Freedom, Trump Says
item.description: U.S. president Donald Trump said goaltender Connor Hellebuyck will soon be presented with the highest civilian honor and praised him for his 41-save gold medal game performance.
